title: Artifact Spell Slot vs Nether Stone

subjects.name: Artifact Spell Slot with a Nether Stone spell

problem: Confirmed. The chance left over from the Nether-stone loop is reused for the artifact Spell Slot, so the Smith bonus is lost and The Truth's 100% carries over.
notes: Community claim: If the Nether Stone has a spell, the artifact slot starts from the Nether chance: no Smith bonus, and The Truth makes it always fire. Evidence: bc_OnAttack L2569-2606: = base @0x1413b07c1, Nether loop = base @0x1413b0e49 / The Truth = 100 @0x1413b1044, no reset before the artifact roll. Fix sketch: S: redo the base (and Smith) assignment after the Nether loop Triage 2026-10-26: Nether chance carries over to the artifact Spell Slot (Smith bonus lost, The Truth = 100%). Hook: recompute the base (+ Smith) before the artifact roll. Batch R: not built. The chance is reassigned by the Nether-stone loop (L2573-2577) and the artifact roll (L2586+) reuses it; a correct fix must save base+Smith after L2571 and restore it before the artifact roll, across several statements. Needs a deeper decode of the L2570-2591 chance flow before patching. Round-2 hook (A2): call-free detours save the artifact Spell Slot chance after base + Smith (bc_OnAttack L2573) and restore it before the artifact roll (L2586), keyed by the frame. In-game test: a Nether Stone with a spell + The Truth: the artifact Spell Slot no longer always fires; with the Smith card set its base chance is x1.1.

release_notes.effect: Artifact Spell Slot with a Nether Stone spell
release_notes.intended: The Artifact's Spell Slot has its own chance to cast (raised by the Smith card set).
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, it reused the chance left over from the Nether Stone's spells, losing the Smith bonus or keeping a 100% chance from The Truth.
release_notes.fix: Now the Artifact's chance starts from its own base, plus the Smith bonus.
